_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (±2pt moves only 16% of recent windows) plus neutral 30d momentum/funding keep the rung pinned; inflows are a risk flag not yet a breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary, but analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief vs narrative inflow/top-risk tone without a clean forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 50-62, 30d momentum near neutral, funding/CVD flat, and score stays inside Disbelief band
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed exits 47-62 with momentum, CVD, and funding aligned the same direction, or exchange netflow reverses hard while price breaks range
